description: Startup and shutdown transient for the Ignis-M1 chamber.  A 2 ms fuel lead, a 35 ms valve ramp, an igniter-driven efficiency ramp reaching 0.92 at 20 ms, a 0.6 s burn and a near-simultaneous shutdown.  The valve timing keeps the chamber mixture ratio inside the tabulated range throughout, which the zero-dimensional products model requires.
